generatedFrom: Measurements taken on the reference machine (Fedora 44, AMD Ryzen AI MAX+ 395, 17 Nov 2026). Sizes and digests are of files actually downloaded and used, not values copied from a web page.

assets.notes: fp16 ONNX export of Kokoro-82M. Verified to have NO 'durations' output, so it cannot supply native phoneme timings. Word-level highlighting of English prose therefore comes from the optional local forced aligner (mfa-english-acoustic and mfa-english-uk-dictionary below; ADR-0004), which aligns the spoken script against this model's final trimmed PCM. Without the aligner, and always for equations, narration uses clip-boundary (sentence/equation) cues.

61 .npy voice files shipped inside the KokoroSharp NuGet package. Not downloaded separately. PackageReference does not copy a package's 'content' folder to the output directory, so KokoroProviderSettings.LocatePackageVoices() resolves them from the global packages cache; override with KokoroVoicesDirectory.
Only needed if the ZONOS3 provider is selected. Requires a zonos3-server or zonos3-cli built from source; no prebuilt binary is distributed here.
Full-size decoder (head 'full_mr'). The smaller keep-2 variant was measured by halo-prep as noticeably worse (loudness range 8.1 LU vs 3.0 LU), so the full decoder is the one referenced here.
Needed for reference-clip voice conditioning. Speaker-embedding voices (the default) do not require it at generation time.

Copied beside the application by the package's buildTransitive target, so recognition of Latin-script scans works with no extra download. Recognition quality depends on raster resolution; the extraction pipeline requests 1920px when OCR is on and reports sparse coverage rather than treating an empty transcript as success.

assets.component: Semantic layout model (block roles incl. display maths)
assets.source: https://huggingface.co/stefanj0/PP-DocLayoutV3-ONNX/resolve/main/PP-DocLayoutV3.onnx (RailReaderCore LayoutModelRegistry); downloaded only from Models and endpoints > Download layout model
assets.notes: Used automatically once installed in the models directory (or set LayoutModelPath). Supplies block roles, so narration skips running headers, footers, page numbers, footnotes, references and figures, announces tables and algorithms instead of reading their cells, and takes display formulas from the model rather than geometry. Without it the model-free TextLayoutAnalyzer labels every block as text and those features fall back to geometric heuristics.

assets.notes: Only needed for word-by-word prose highlighting. Installed by the explicit setup script, never by the application, into $XDG_DATA_HOME/rail-narrator/alignment together with a micromamba environment (MFA 3.3.9, Kalpy 0.10.5, Kaldi 5.5.1172, Python 3.11) that is several GB and is not listed as a single file here. Its hash is folded into the alignment revision, so replacing it retimes cached audio without resynthesis. See docs/word-highlighting.md.

excluded.reason: ZONOS3's /v2/edit/align belongs to the speech-editing feature set and needs an edit backbone, encoder companions and a Python worker with fusealign-hub. A synthesis-only installation does not have them, and their presence in documentation is not evidence this install can use them. Sentence and equation highlighting ships without any aligner, and word highlighting uses the local MFA aligner listed above instead of this endpoint.
